'''Hanns-Peter Boehm''' (9 January 1928<ref>''Who's who in Germany: a biographical encyclopedia containing some 23,000 biographies of prominent personalities in Germany and a listing of 2,400 organizations, Issue 6,'' Page 126, Who's Who Book & Publ., 1976</ref> – 10 May 2022)<ref>[https://trauer.sueddeutsche.de/traueranzeige/hanns-peter-boehm Hanns-Peter Boehm] {{in lang|de}}</ref> was a German [[chemist]] and professor [[emeritus]] at [[Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München]] (LMU [[Munich]]) in Germany. Boehm is considered a pioneer of [[graphene]] research.<ref name="Boehm1962">{{cite journal |last1 =Boehm |first1 =H. P. |last2 =Clauss |first2 =A. |last3 =Fischer |first3 =G. O. |last4 =Hofmann |first4 =U. |title =Das Adsorptionsverhalten sehr dünner Kohlenstoff-Folien |journal =Zeitschrift für anorganische und allgemeine Chemie |volume =316 |pages =119–127 |year =1962 |doi =10.1002/zaac.19623160303 |issue =3–4}}</ref><ref name="Boehm2010">{{cite journal |last1 =Boehm |first1 =Hanns-Peter |title =Graphen - wie eine Laborkuriosität plötzlich äußerst interessant wurde |journal =Angewandte Chemie |pages = 9520–9523|year =2010 |doi =10.1002/ange.201004096 |volume =122 |issue =49|bibcode =2010AngCh.122.9520B }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Hanns-Peter Boehm studied [[chemistry]] in [[Regensburg]] from 1947 to 1951. He received his doctorate in 1953 at [[Technische Universität Darmstadt]],<ref>Hanns-Peter Boehm. ''Die rhomboedrische Modifikation des Graphits''. Technische Hochschule Darmstadt. Dissertation vom 6. Juli 1953</ref> where he also received his [[habilitation]] in 1959 with the treatise ''Oberflächenchemie und Adsorption an Kohlenstoff und SiO<sub>2</sub>''. In 1961, Boehm, together with [[Ralph Setton]] and [[Eberhard Stumpp]], isolated and identified single graphene sheets by [[transmission electron microscopy]] (TEM) and [[X-ray diffraction]]. In 1986 they authored the [[IUPAC]] (International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry) report formally defining the term [[graphene]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.britannica.com/EBchecked/topic/1236225/graphene|title = Graphene &#124; chemistry &#124; Britannica}}</ref> In 1970 Boehm became professor and director of the Institute for Inorganic Chemistry of [[LMU Munich]]; in 1994 he retired to the status of [[professor emeritus]].
